tools.meta.title: Image Tools — ImgFeel
tools.meta.description: Free browser-based image tools. Resize images instantly without uploading.
tools.page.title: Image Tools
tools.page.subtitle: Free browser-based tools to edit your images privately.
tools.imageResizer.title: Image Resizer
tools.imageResizer.description: Resize images to exact dimensions or by percentage. Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP.
tools.exactResizer.title: Resize Image to Exact Dimensions
tools.exactResizer.description: Set precise pixel width and height with aspect ratio locking, center crop, or letterbox padding.
tools.webpCompressor.title: WebP Image Compressor
tools.webpCompressor.description: Compress and optimize WebP images to custom quality levels or target KB sizes with zero quality loss.
tools.cmMmResizer.title: Resize Image in CM & MM
tools.cmMmResizer.description: Resize images to physical dimensions in centimeters or millimeters for printing with custom DPI.
tools.panCardResizer.title: PAN Card Document Resizer
tools.panCardResizer.description: Resize and compress PAN card images by dimensions or KB file size for online portal submissions privately.
tools.whatsappDpResizer.title: WhatsApp DP Resizer
tools.whatsappDpResizer.description: Fit full photos with blurred backgrounds, zoom, and crop to a 1:1 square for WhatsApp profile pictures with live circle preview.
tools.sscResizer.title: SSC Photo & Signature Resizer
tools.sscResizer.description: Prepare 100% verified SSC exam photos (20–50 KB) and signatures (10–20 KB) using official portal presets.
tools.youtubeBannerResizer.title: YouTube Banner Resizer
tools.youtubeBannerResizer.description: Crop, fit, and position channel art to exact 2560 × 1440 px YouTube banner dimensions with live Safe Area overlay.
tools.base64Converter.title: Image to Base64 Converter
tools.base64Converter.description: Convert images (JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, GIF) to Base64 Data URLs with 1-click HTML & CSS code generators.
tools.dataUriConverter.title: Image to Data URI Converter
tools.dataUriConverter.description: Generate RFC 2397 Data URIs for images (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP) for instant inline HTML and CSS embedding.
tools.dimensionsChecker.title: Image Dimensions Checker
tools.dimensionsChecker.description: Check pixel dimensions, aspect ratio, megapixels, DPI print sizes, EXIF camera metadata, and color palette instantly.
tools.fileSizeChecker.title: Image File Size Checker
tools.fileSizeChecker.description: Check image file size in Bytes, KB, and MB, evaluate compression density (BPP), and simulate network download speeds.
tools.resolutionChecker.title: Image Resolution Checker
tools.resolutionChecker.description: Check image resolution, pixel dimensions, megapixels, 300 DPI print sizes, and screen display clarity instantly.
tools.aspectRatioChecker.title: Image Aspect Ratio Checker
tools.aspectRatioChecker.description: Find exact aspect ratios, decimal proportions, social media dimensions, and responsive CSS aspect-ratio code instantly.
tools.dpiChecker.title: Image DPI Checker
tools.dpiChecker.description: Check image DPI, PPI density, physical print dimensions, and printing format suitability with 100% in-browser privacy.
tools.formatChecker.title: Online Image Format Checker
tools.formatChecker.description: Accurately detect the true file format, MIME type, compression type, and binary magic bytes of any image with 100% in-browser privacy.
tools.squareResizer.title: Resize Image to 1:1 (Square Resizer)
tools.squareResizer.description: Convert any landscape or portrait image into a perfect 1:1 square aspect ratio with smart crop, blur background padding, or custom dimensions.
tools.circleCropper.title: Circle Image Cropper (Round Profile Picture Maker)
tools.circleCropper.description: Crop any photo into a clean circular cutout with transparent PNG/WebP alpha corners, pan & zoom controls, and decorative ring borders.
tools.grayscaleConverter.title: Image Grayscale Converter (Black & White Photo Maker)
tools.grayscaleConverter.description: Convert color photos into high-quality grayscale and black and white images with interactive split slider, ITU-R BT.709 luminance, and custom tone filters.
tools.imageInverter.title: Image Inverter (Invert Image Colors & Negative Maker)
tools.imageInverter.description: Invert image colors to create negative photo effects, invert dark/light mode documents, and isolate RGB channels with 100% in-browser privacy.
tools.imageBlur.title: Image Blur Tool (Blur Photo & Bokeh Background Maker)
tools.imageBlur.description: Blur photos, create bokeh background effects, and redact sensitive credentials with Gaussian blur, dreamy glow, and 100% in-browser privacy.
tools.imageStitcher.title: Image Stitching Tool (Merge & Combine Photos Online)
tools.imageStitcher.description: Combine multiple photos into one image horizontally, vertically, or in grid collages with custom spacing, smart size matching, and 100% in-browser privacy.
tools.videoTrimmer.title: Video Trimmer
tools.videoTrimmer.description: Trim, cut, and shorten video clips online with interactive visual timeline controls, audio toggle, and 100% in-browser privacy.
tools.videoRotator.title: Video Rotator
tools.videoRotator.description: Rotate, turn, and mirror flip video clips (90°, 180°, 270°) online with live preview and 100% in-browser privacy.
